item.title: American Kate Douglass sets 50-meter freestyle world record at Pan Pacific
item.description: Kate Douglass, 24, is a five-time Olympic medalist.

item.title: Iran hits another vessel in Strait of Hormuz amid Israel's escalated Lebanon offensive
item.description: Lebanese officials condemn Israeli strikes in the south that reportedly killed at least 11 people, including children, per the health ministry.

item.title: South Carolina to host first 2028 Democratic presidential primary
item.description: South Carolina's Democratic primary is set for Jan. 22, 2028, with Nevada, New Hampshire, New Mexico, Michigan, and Virginia also scheduled.

item.title: Five injured in shooting at Virginia State University
item.description: The shooting involved multiple suspects; one victim is in critical condition, according to the university.
